physicalNotes: No radius or mass of Orion Nebula is recorded: it is an extended nebula, and its package frames it at 4.817 pc (object.json worldFrame.bodyRadiusM), a presentation value.

sources.position: ESO ESO · optical image and publisher astrometry; registration retained in the observation recipe (https://cdn.eso.org/images/publicationtiff/eso1723a.tif); catalogue reference m42-registered-images
sources.distance: Menten et al. (2007), The distance to the Orion Nebula (https://arxiv.org/abs/0709.0485); catalogue reference menten-2007: 414 pc (-7/+7); Adopted published trigonometric parallax; not a fitted image scale.
sources.properMotion: Zero: the nebula is held at its catalogued position; no motion across the sky is applied.
